newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks advance as Brazil jitters dissipate.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks advance as Brazil jitters dissipate.

text.p: Mexican shares extended earlier gains at midday dealing on Wednesday on light bargain-hunting by local dealers relieved that Brazilian equity markets has recovered from Tuesday's dive, traders said.
"The market looked cheap to local bottom-fishers who then stepped in, but foreigners are still on the sidelines," a desk trader said.
The leading IPC share index .MXX was up 58.92 points, or 1.26 percent, at 4,753.27. The blue chip Bovespa index in Sao Paulo was meanwhile up 5.54 percent to 12,260 points.
Volume .TV.MX was slow at 58.9 million shares due to the lack of foreign investors in the market, whom dealers said appeared to have turned their attention to Brazil.
Dealers said local buyers had also taken heart from record gains on Wall Street and a positive outlook for domestic unemployment data due on Thursday.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up 40.64 points to 8,016.35.
On the broad market, gainers outstripped sliders by 61 to 22 of a total of 104 stocks traded.
